Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP & Exchange: Evaluation artifacts, sandbox access window, and acceptance milestones

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, here is a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to exchange the evaluation assets (prompt pack + candidate test cases) and a short pilot runway so your team can validate model fit. High-level asks / commitments below; attached are the first-pass artifacts (promptpack_v1.zip, testcases_sample.csv) and a draft MAP (MAP_Draft_Vertex_v1.docx).

High-level MAP (proposed)
- Delivery: Redwood provides access to a sandbox project containing the prompt pack and a 2500-row testcase sample by 2025-11-14.
- Access window: Ephemeral sandbox credentials for 45 days from first access (no external redistribution).
- Acceptance criteria: Vertex agrees to run 3 acceptance prompt families and report precision/recall on the provided evaluation harness within the access window.
- Takedown / destruction: Vertex confirms secure deletion of raw testcases and derived models within 14 days after access ends; Redwood provides a destruction receipt.
- Data handling: No dataset redistribution; results summaries are OK for internal evaluation and procurement purposes.

Open questions for you:
1) Is 45 days sufficient for your QA cadence, or would you prefer 90 days?
2) Procurement needs a SOW + invoicing details — should we route that to procurement@vertexretail.com?

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the access window and acceptance criteria by EOD Tue (11/11).
- We finalize the MAP and DocuSign it by 11/17 to hit a 11/18 sandbox spin-up.

Attachments referenced:
- promptpack_v1.zip (prompt families, README)
- testcases_sample.csv (2500 sample rows, blinded PII)
- MAP_Draft_Vertex_v1.docx (MAP + usage constraints and takedown clauses)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if you want to walk through the acceptance steps.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks for the clear questions. We can accept 45 days as the default sandbox window and will include a one-time 15-day extension option (administrative request required). A few specifics we will include in the MAP:

- Usage constraints (explicit):
  * No public redistribution of promptpack_v1.zip or testcases_sample.csv.
  * No upload of Vertex testcases or prompt content to public model-sharing platforms or repos.
  * Derived metrics/aggregates are permitted for internal reporting and procurement.
- Retention and takedown:

  * Redwood will provide a signed destruction receipt (PDF) within 7 days of verification.
- Security:
  * Sandbox credentials use ephemeral API keys with read-only controls and activity logs retained for 90 days for auditability.
